org.projectJoined: You now have access to the project.
org.moveBody: It will count against {{org}}’s plan. Everyone on the project must already be a member of {{org}}.
org.highestPlan: You're on the largest plan sold online. Contact sales for Enterprise.
org.billingUnavailable: Contact support to change plans. Online upgrades are unavailable.
org.billingReadOnly: Only owners and admins can change the plan. Ask {{owners}}.
org.noAudit: No events recorded for this organization.
org.exportBody: Download a JSON export of {{org}} with its people, project specifications, policies, plan and audit log. It excludes passwords, tokens and project credentials.
org.mfaImpact_one: {{count}} member has yet to turn on two-factor authentication.
org.mfaImpact_other: {{count}} members have yet to turn on two-factor authentication.
org.mfaPolicyHint: Members need a second factor to open this organization or its projects. SSO sign-ins count.
org.allowSupport: Allow platform support to view as organization members
org.mfaBody: {{count}} members who haven't turned on two-factor will lose access to {{org}} until they do. Members who have it will need to sign in with their code.
org.supportTitle: Stop platform support from viewing as your members?
org.supportBody: Active support sessions end immediately. Support will no longer be able to view the app as your members.
org.approvalHelp: Set stricter approval rules for this organization. Blank or unchecked settings follow the platform policy.
org.noAutoPlan: Disable automatic approval of small plan edits
org.resetApprovalsBody: Remove this organization's approval overrides and use the platform policy.
org.ownKey: Your own provider key is in use ({{hint}}).
org.platformKey: The platform provider key is in use.
org.removeKeyBody: AI requests will use the platform provider key.
org.removeBudgetBody: Clear the monthly AI budget for this organization.
org.clearLimitBody: Remove the usage limit for this metric.
org.usageReadOnly: Only owners can set usage limits.
org.noScim: SCIM provisioning is not included in this organization's plan.
org.scimRotated: Support replaced this token and paused SCIM. Generate a new token and update your identity provider.
org.scimTokenOnce: Copy this token into your identity provider now. It appears only once.
org.scimTokenSaved: I saved the token in my identity provider
org.rotateBody: The current token stops working immediately. Update your identity provider right away.
org.turnScimOffBody: The identity provider's sync requests are refused until you turn SCIM back on. People stay in the organization.
org.removeScimBody: People stay in the organization. The token and synced user and group records are deleted.
org.certCurrent: Stored certificate · {{subject}} · {{fingerprint}} · Expires {{date}}. Paste the certificate to save SAML settings.
org.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the stored client secret.
org.trustEmail: Trust email addresses the identity provider has not verified
org.domainsHelp: Prove ownership with a DNS TXT record. Only addresses on verified domains can sign in through your identity provider.
org.dnsHelp: Add the TXT record at your domain host, then select Verify.
org.removeDomainBody: People with addresses on this domain can no longer sign in through your identity provider.
org.testHelp: A test signs you in at your identity provider without changing this session.
org.turnSsoOffBody: People on your domains go back to signing in with a password. People who have only used SSO will need to set a password.
org.turnSsoOnTitle: Turn on SSO without a passing test?
org.turnSsoOnBody: Run a test sign-in first to make sure people can sign in.
org.removeSsoBody: The identity provider settings are deleted. Verified domains stay.
org.checkOk: Everything needed for SSO is in place.
org.noSso: Single sign-on is not included in this organization's plan.

checklist.title: Setup checklist
checklist.intro: Work through these steps in any order. Come back here to see what is left.
checklist.error: Some checklist details could not be loaded.
checklist.modelBody: Add the things your backend stores, such as posts or customers.
checklist.authKeycloak: Sign-in is handled by Keycloak. Email, registration and token settings are here.
checklist.authBody: Skip this if your API does not need user accounts.
checklist.keycloakOn: Keycloak manages your users, with social logins, MFA and an admin console.
checklist.keycloakBody: Use Keycloak for sign-in, SSO across projects, Google or Microsoft logins and MFA.
checklist.paymentsOn: Card payments, refunds and disputes are switched on, with workers sized for your load.
checklist.paymentsBody: Hosted checkout with Stripe or Razorpay, refunds, an audit trail and deployment files sized for your traffic.
checklist.storageOn: Any file type, scanned for malware before it is stored, with an audit trail.
checklist.storageBody: Let people upload files of any type to S3 or a MinIO-compatible store, virus-scanned, with role-based access.
checklist.accessBody: Create roles, then give them access to your data.
checklist.generateBody: Download a complete API with tests and Docker setup.

behavior.ownerOnly: Only a project owner can change this. Editors and viewers can read it.
behavior.forbidden: Your project role does not allow this action.
behavior.loadError: We could not load the supporting project information.

behavior.removeDescription: This item will be removed when you save the section.

events.intro: Configure the outbox that delivers changes to webhooks, notification types and your own code.
events.name: Event
events.emptyHelp: Turn on events so webhooks, notifications and your own code can react to changes. You need at least one entity.
events.adapterHelp: Use in_process. The redis_streams adapter is unavailable.
events.dependencies: Outgoing webhooks and event-triggered notification types depend on events.
events.exclusions: Event data excludes secret-looking, JSON and protected fields. On updates, changed lists the published fields whose values changed.
events.howHelp: Events arrive in order per record. Handlers may see repeats. A failed delivery retries with growing waits up to five minutes apart. After eight attempts it blocks later events for that record.

effects.intro: Allow trusted hooks to send email, SMS, webhooks and notifications. Webhooks can only go to hosts on the allow-list.
effects.empty: Hook effects are not set up
effects.emptyHelp: Set up hook effects to let trusted hooks send email, SMS, webhooks and notifications.
effects.disableHelp: Hooks that declare effects require this setting to stay enabled.
effects.prerequisites: Enable the integration used by each declared effect. At least one hook is required.
effects.trustedRequired: Confirm trusted authors only to enable hook effects.

intro.settings: Runtime settings are values your app’s admins can change without a redeploy, such as a VAT rate or approval threshold.
intro.sequences: A sequence hands out gapless, formatted numbers such as INV-00042.
intro.lists: Lists are dropdown choices that admins can change without a redeploy, such as ticket categories.

settings.name: Name
settings.label: Label
settings.secretHelp: Settings are readable through the API. Keep secrets in the provider vault.
settings.boundHelp: Choose a required, unique field with no default. Use a string for formatted numbers or a bigint for a plain counter.

hooks.intro: Declare where your code runs in a record’s life and set its inputs, outputs and limits.
hooks.emptyHelp: Declare a hook to see the contract and the stub file the generator will create.
hooks.noEntity: Add an entity in the data model first. A hook belongs to a point of an entity.
hooks.missing: No hook named “{{name}}” in this project. It may have been renamed or removed.
hooks.name: Hook name
hooks.nameHelp: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
hooks.pureHelp: Only pure is possible at this point.
hooks.effectHelp: An effect runs after the commit. Owners can configure outbound effects.
hooks.effectsOn: Only trusted authors can use outbound effects. Enable the integration for each selected effect.
hooks.effectsOff: Enable Hook effects and the relevant integrations to run these effects.
hooks.effectsValue: {{calls}} calls per effect · {{bytes}} bytes · {{rate}} per minute
hooks.gate: Run the gate in your generated project
hooks.gateHelp: Generate and unpack the project, write the body of the stub, then run the hook checks.
hooks.stubMissing: Give the hook a name, a point and model names to see its stub.

seed.intro: Define repeatable sample rows for demos and development in your generated project.
seed.emptyHelp: Add a profile and choose how many rows each entity gets.
seed.noEntity: Add an entity in the data model first. An entity plan fills one entity.
seed.profileLimit: A project can have at most five seed profiles.
seed.name: Profile name
seed.numberHelp: The same number always gives the same rows.
seed.tenantsHelp: Use 0 unless the project is multi-tenant.
seed.total: Total rows for this profile: {{count}} of {{max}} allowed (10,000 per entity).
seed.rowsPerTenant: Rows per tenant. Up to 10,000 across all tenants.
seed.generatorUnavailable: This generator is unavailable for this field. Choose a different generator or remove the field plan.

generatorHint.constant: The same value in every row.
generatorHint.one_of: A value picked from a list.
generatorHint.sequence: A value that counts up for each row.
generatorHint.int_range: A whole number between two bounds.
generatorHint.decimal_range: A decimal number between two bounds.
generatorHint.bool_ratio: True for a share of the rows.
generatorHint.reference: Points at a seeded row of another entity.
generatorHint.state: A reachable state, chosen by weight.

seed.onePerLine: Enter one value per line, up to 100 values.
seed.runHelp: Run these commands from your generated project after you unpack it.

command.reset: Delete and recreate this profile’s data
command.resetOnly: Remove only this profile’s seeded rows

seed.guard: Use a development environment, such as APP_ENV=development. ENVIRONMENT, when set, must also name a development environment.

custom.intro: Define extra fields for an entity. Check existing values before promoting a field to a real column.
custom.emptyHelp: Add a field to store extra values on rows of this entity.
custom.noEntitiesHelp: Add an entity in the data model before defining custom fields.
custom.limits: {{count}} of {{max}} fields · {{bytes}} byte limit per row
custom.valuesHelp: Enter one value per line. Leave blank to allow any value.
custom.removeHelp: The definition will be removed. Existing values stay in their rows.
custom.checkError: We could not check this field for promotion. Run the check again.
custom.writeError: We could not update custom fields. Review any field errors and try again.
custom.promoteHelp: This changes your schema and records the migration in change history.
custom.samplesHelp: Paste a JSON array with up to 1,000 values, or run the check without samples.
custom.ack: I understand this is not proven and the change may fail on existing data.
custom.promoted: Promoted {{name}} to a column. Change {{seq}} was recorded.

behavior.checkFields: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
behavior.saveTooLarge: The request body is too large.
behavior.saveSecret: A secret cannot be stored in the spec. Keep it in the provider vault.
